home.title: Software Development & System Integration | HDN Technologies
home.description: HDN Technologies is a software engineering company in Plovdiv, Bulgaria. We build custom software, integrate business systems and engineer real-time machine-to-cloud communication for businesses across the EU.

hero.title: Software engineering and system integration from Plovdiv, for businesses across the EU.
hero.lead: HDN Technologies is a Bulgarian engineering company. We build custom software, connect business systems, and engineer real-time communication between machines and cloud services – including remote-service communication for the automotive industry.

services.title: Services
services.intro: We take responsibility for the engineering: from the first architecture decision to a system running in production.

items.title: Consulting
items.forWhom: For teams planning a new system or modernising an existing one.
items.body: Architecture reviews, technology selection and modernisation roadmaps. You get a written assessment of your current landscape and a concrete, prioritised plan your team can act on.

items.title: System Integration
items.forWhom: For companies whose ERP, CRM, e-commerce or industrial systems need to work together.
items.body: We design and build the interfaces and data flows between your systems, so the right data reaches the right place reliably – and the integration keeps working when one side changes.

items.title: Software Development
items.forWhom: For products and internal tools that off-the-shelf software cannot cover.
items.body: Custom backends, APIs and applications, from concept to a maintained production system – including databases, automated CI/CD pipelines and documentation.

process.title: How an engagement works
process.intro: A clear, predictable path from first conversation to a running system.

steps.title: Introductory call
steps.body: We discuss your goals, existing systems and constraints, and whether we are the right fit.

steps.title: Technical assessment
steps.body: We review the current landscape and propose an architecture, scope and delivery plan in writing.

steps.title: Iterative delivery
steps.body: We build in short increments with regular demos, so you see progress and can adjust priorities early.

steps.title: Handover and support
steps.body: Documentation, deployment pipelines and knowledge transfer – plus ongoing support if you need it.

items.q: Where is HDN Technologies based, and who do you work with?
items.a: HDN Technologies (Ейч Ди Ен Технолоджийс ЕООД) is a software engineering company based in Plovdiv, Bulgaria. We work with businesses in Bulgaria and across the European Union.

We provide consulting, system integration and custom software development: architecture and system design, APIs, data flows, databases, real-time communication and CI/CD pipelines – from the first design decision to a system running in production.

items.q: Do you have experience with real-time systems?
items.a: Yes. Over a two-year engagement completed in 2026, we engineered a real-time teleservice communication platform for the automotive industry, including real-time communication between machines and backend services with SignalR. Client details are confidential under NDA.
Yes. If you need a non-disclosure agreement before sharing details about your systems or product, mention it in your first email and we will sign it before going into detail.

Send a short email to sales@hdntechnologies.com describing what you need. We follow up with an introductory call and then a written technical assessment with a proposed architecture, scope and delivery plan.

items.q: Which languages do you work in?
items.a: We work in English and Bulgarian.

sections.title: Who is responsible
paragraphs: The controller of your personal data is Ейч Ди Ен Технолоджийс ЕООД (HDN Technologies EOOD), registered in the Bulgarian Commercial Register under UIC (ЕИК) 207848269, VAT number BG207848269, based in Plovdiv, Bulgaria.
You can contact us about data protection at sales@hdntechnologies.com.

sections.title: Visiting this website
paragraphs: This website is a static site. It sets no cookies, uses no analytics or tracking, and loads no fonts, scripts or other resources from third parties.

The site is hosted on GitHub Pages, operated by GitHub, Inc. (USA). When you load a page, GitHub processes technical data such as your IP address in its server logs to deliver the site and keep it secure. Transfers to the USA rely on the EU–US Data Privacy Framework. Our legal basis is our legitimate interest in operating a secure website (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).

sections.title: Contacting us by email
paragraphs: If you email us, we process your name, email address and the content of your message to answer your enquiry and, where relevant, to prepare or perform a contract (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR) or based on our legitimate interest in responding to business correspondence (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).
We keep this correspondence only as long as needed to handle your enquiry and any resulting business relationship, or as long as Bulgarian law requires.

sections.title: Your rights
paragraphs: You have the right to access, rectify and erase your data, to restrict or object to its processing, and to data portability. To exercise these rights, email sales@hdntechnologies.com.
You also have the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority. In Bulgaria, this is the Commission for Personal Data Protection (Комисия за защита на личните данни, cpdp.bg).
